title: Show page-only supplier aging amount summaries in report designer
description: A purchasing user selects a finite monetary summary and sees currency-separated current-page totals with explicit unknowns beside the dynamic supplier-aging preview. The static report and row exports remain available. Development only; reuse ERP-140 authorized, bounded read-only supplier-aging preview and existing HTTP audit. Work solely on the current page. Preserve explicit unknown due dates, invalid/unknown allocation evidence, draft/void separation and currency isolation. Missing permission or invalid grouping fails closed. No new schema, migration, production SQL, real database execution, payment action, ledger inference, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets/.env or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Designer exposes only ERP-146 monetary summary modes and sends them with the existing authorized filtered page request.

Summary view labels supplier, currency, optional aging bucket, active gross, allocated and arithmetic remaining evidence; unknown values remain unknown, draft/void exclusions are explained, and empty/permission/network states are visible.
Node tests cover mode selection, currency separation, unknown and draft/void indicators, safe text rendering, paging and failures; document summary and download scope.
